definitions.explanation: The physical energy and endurance of the body.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}が{落|お}ちた。
{体力|たいりょく}{勝負|しょうぶ}になる。
examples.english: It becomes a test of endurance.

notes:
{体力|たいりょく} is composed of {体|たい} (body) + {力|りょく} (power).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体力|たいりょく}をつける: to build stamina
- {体力|たいりょく}が{ある|ない}: to have/lack stamina
- {体力|たいりょく}{測定|そくてい}: physical fitness test
- {体力|たいりょく}{的|てき}に: physically

RELATED WORDS:
- {筋力|きんりょく}: muscular strength
- {持久力|じきゅうりょく}: endurance
- {気力|きりょく}: mental strength, willpower
